title: Harness pause/resume parse rejection paths have zero automated coverage
detail: Four new rejection branches in this diff, none tested: grep shows parse_demo is called only by production code (run.odin:223,571) and harness/ has zero @(test) procs. Verification was manual ("review r1: verified" comments), violating the repo's own drift.odin precedent: gates must be PROVEN in CI.
recommended_fix: Add unit tests feeding the four bad directives (double-pause, resume-without-pause, bad pause arity, bad resume arity) to parse_demo and asserting the error strings; or a failure-demo fixture list the harness runs negatively.

title: apply_tick_at trailing-pause and multiple-window branches never exercised
detail: Back-compat and mid-pause lowering are covered (verified: 24 pre-existing goldens unshifted; pause.dem edit at apply_tick 1211). But no demo or test exercises a trailing pause (re = max(u64)), multiple pause windows, or a harness-level post-resume command: demos/pause.dem's last directive pair is "at 70000ms resume" with nothing after.
recommended_fix: Extend core/pause_test.odin or add a second demo with two pause windows, a trailing pause at run end, and one edit logged after resume; pin the resulting apply_ticks/hashes.

title: Paused-state STABLE violation checks never proven to bite
evidence:
append(&fails, fmt.aprintf("paused state STABLE violation at wall tick %d: hash moved %016x -> %016x",
...
				append(fails, fmt.aprintf("replay: paused state STABLE violation at wall tick %d: hash moved %016x -> %016x",
detail: Both new loud-failure branches are dead in every test: no harness tests exist, and drift-check's 7 mutation classes (catalog_hash, logic_hz, magic, version, tag, era, truncation) mutate log bytes only — they cannot move a paused-window hash since paused ticks never step. Unlike the replay gate, this gate's rejection is unproven.
recommended_fix: Add a negative check (drift-check style) that injects a deliberately mismatched pause schedule into the Demo_Replay cfg and asserts replay_hashes fails with the stability-violation message.

title: App-layer pause surface untested — honestly delegated to golden/core level
detail: P/SPACE toggle, Paused overlay, and stepping gate have no automated tests, but app/ contains zero test procs by architecture (raylib input/render). Delegation is honest: the stepping-freeze contract is pinned by pause.dem T1 plus core/pause_test.odin; the bundle refresh is documented derived state.
recommended_fix: None required for this PR. Optionally extract the mode-toggle decision into a pure helper later if app-layer tests ever land.

title: pause_test clause (a) baseline holds only vacuously — fixture emits zero events
detail: The hash folds the event stream (serialize.odin:411 w_u32(len(tick_events))), and the harness golden shows first paused hash != last stepped hash (t1: 1210 df84240b8304c0d5, 1211 d3600eef9503b6d9). The test's stronger window==last-stepped equality passes only because its fixture has zero demand (no events). Adding traffic later would spuriously fail (a).
recommended_fix: Match the harness convention: baseline the window on the FIRST paused hash (like pause_base in run.odin), then optionally add demand so packets/events actually freeze.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (6/6 execution-verified: 158/158 core tests, 25/25 demos green with 24 pre-existing goldens unshifted, drift-check 174/174). P1 ~90% (post-resume lowering pinned only at core level). Overall ~75%: 8 P2 error/edge behaviours at NONE (4 parse rejections, trailing pause, multi-window, 2 stability branches).
recommended_fix: Pin the four parse rejections, add trailing-pause/multi-window/post-resume coverage, and prove the stability-violation gate bites via schedule injection; that lifts overall above 80%.
